comment: PERSONAL Databox profile (CIV-A01) — a person's own vault on their own machine.
Layer 1 of the profile ladder for the person side: a standard, file-backed Solid pod
with WebID/OIDC identity, WAC access control and an LDN inbox. Everything here degrades
to ordinary Solid: a vanilla Solid client can use this server fully.
Deliberately ABSENT versus config/databox/live.json (the organisation profile):
- no LiveDataboxHttpHandler / Smithy control plane (/.databox/smithy does not exist here)
- no databoxControlToken — there is no control plane to authenticate to
- no IPMS module registry, POS, hosting or organisation tooling
The person-facing Databox surface (CIV-A07) mounts at /.databox/personal: connection-
credential install target, per-program connection registry, notify-then-pull vault sync,
cursor recovery, evidence export and scoped submission. It authenticates to the OWNER's
WebID via --databoxPersonalOwnerWebId and trusts connection-credential issuers from
--databoxPersonalIssuerKeys (JSON issuer→public-JWK map). Never a shared bearer token.
